notes.title: Update:
notes.content:
1. The character controller has been rewritten and updated:
a) Animation of braking after running was added.
b) The definition of cliffs mechanics and the animation of standing on it was added.
c) The mechanics of height determination was changed.
d) The new fall animation was added, the animation and hard landing mechanics were added.
2. The Catapult mechanics  was rewritten, it was necessary to abandon physics.
3. Fixed bug of disappearance of UI after dialogs.
4. Minor changes on the levels.
5. Size of the game was reduced slightly.
